user.title: Connect to your MCU
user.description: Enter the MCU's IP address or hostname and web login. MQTT is not required. Complete the MCU's initial setup first.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect. Check the host and complete initial MCU setup.
error.invalid_host: Enter only a host or HTTP(S) origin, without a path or credentials.
error.unsupported_firmware: Update the MCU to firmware 2.0.31 or later.

abort.wrong_master: This address belongs to a different MCU.
